_date: DERIVED from the level number — see game/calendar.ts. Shift 6 is Thursday 12 March (night).
_verdict_mode: Pass, Warning or Fine. One warning before a fine, always.
_teaching: The same clock on vehicles, so it is a clock and not a fact about dumpsters. Introduced expired and inside-its-week on the same night, as with the containers.
briefing: Thursday, after dark. Recreational and inoperable vehicles join the list on the same seven-day clock as the containers. Bins are not within the window.
_cameos: Named residents pinned to addresses rather than rolled. Anything not pinned stays random, so the street is still mostly strangers.
_ambient_animals: The animals loose in yards on this shift. The armadillo is NOT among them tonight — he is the bounty, on one lot only, and a second one wandering past would answer the notice early.
story: Thursday, dark again. Vehicles today: recreational, inoperable, unregistered. Same seven days, same clock.
A working car on its own driveway is not within the Article, whatever the neighbours have written on the board about it.

_artifact.title: Left in the binder pocket
_artifact.text: A photocopy of Article X with one line underlined twice, and no note. The underlining is not yours.

lots._teaching: The dumpster from Tuesday, still there. Warned once, and the grace period does not restart — so this is the fine. Nothing else on the lot.

violations.why: Warned Tuesday. Ten days and counting.

lots._teaching: The vehicle article, introduced expired: an RV on record since 4 March is on day seven. Same clock as the container, different tab in the binder.

violations.why: On record since 4 March. Seven days; the Article allows seven.

lots._teaching: THE PILE, fifth visit and first night. Everything from Tuesday is where it was, and a sofa has joined it on the porch. Nothing on this lot has ever been cleared.

violations.why: Growing here since Wednesday of the first week.
A sofa on the porch. New since Tuesday.

decoys.why: On record 10 March. The Article allows seven days and they have not run out.

lots._teaching: Bins on a Thursday at an address that has never been cited for them, and a dead pickup on the driveway that has been on record eight days. Three articles, all of them first offences here — the case file is long and none of it is about these.

violations.why: A pickup with the windscreen gone, on record eight days.
Out on a Thursday, and in the week between recycling collections.

lots._teaching: TWO DERELICTS, ONE DRIVEWAY, and only one of them is a finding. The red car has been on record since 4 March and is out of time; the green one arrived this morning and has its seven days. Same article, same lot, same look — the case file is the only thing telling them apart. This address has never been cited under the VEHICLE article, so it is a first offence and a warning.

violations.why: On record since 3 March. Eight days.

decoys.why: On record today. The Article allows seven days, and this one has had none of them.
